# fyl.at: anonymous, temporary file sharing.
# For AI agents and LLMs: https://fyl.at/llms.txt explains how to upload, download and delete files.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /llms.txt
# The JSON API, the CLI's binaries and the download service worker are no pages.
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /cli/
Disallow: /_dl/
# Download links (/d/) stay crawlable on purpose: their pages answer "X-Robots-Tag: noindex", which a crawler only
# sees if it may fetch them. Blocking /d/ would let a shared link show up in search results as a bare address.

Sitemap: https://fyl.at/sitemap.xml
